```{r}
# =============================================================================
# Update paths and sample names in the USER SETTINGS section as needed.
# =============================================================================
library(EnhancedVolcano)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)

# 1. Map ENSG IDs to gene symbols

mapGenes <- function(gene_ids) {
  gene_ids <- as.character(gene_ids)   # Ensure keys are character
  mapping <- AnnotationDbi::select(
    org.Hs.eg.db,
    keys      = gene_ids,
    keytype   = "ENSEMBL",
    columns   = c("SYMBOL")
  )
  gene_symbols <- mapping$SYMBOL[match(gene_ids, mapping$ENSEMBL)]
  gene_symbols[is.na(gene_symbols)] <- gene_ids[is.na(gene_symbols)]
  return(gene_symbols)
}

# 2. Get ECM genes from GO:0031012

getECMGenes <- function() {
  ecm_genes <- AnnotationDbi::select(
    org.Hs.eg.db,
    keys    = "GO:0031012",
    keytype = "GOALL",
    columns = "SYMBOL"
  )$SYMBOL
  unique(ecm_genes[!is.na(ecm_genes)])
}

# 3. Main function
getInfo <- function(obj, pcut = 0.2, FC = 0.5, map, save_plot = TRUE, plot_file = NULL) {

  # Ensure gene_id is character
  obj$gene_id <- as.character(obj$gene_id)

  # Ensure padj_manual_noNA exists
  if(!"padj_manual_noNA" %in% colnames(obj)) {
    if("padj" %in% colnames(obj)) {
      obj$padj_manual_noNA <- obj$padj
    } else {
      stop("No padj or padj_manual_noNA column found in the input object")
    }
  }

  # Map ENSG IDs → SYMBOL
  obj$gene_name <- mapGenes(obj$gene_id)

  # Get ECM genes
  ecm_genes <- getECMGenes()

  # 4. Assign gene categories
  obj <- obj %>%
    mutate(
      category = case_when(
        gene_name == "CCL2" ~ "CCL2",
        gene_name %in% ecm_genes ~ "ECM",
        log2FoldChange > FC & padj_manual_noNA < pcut  ~ "up",
        log2FoldChange < -FC & padj_manual_noNA < pcut ~ "down",
        TRUE ~ "not_significant"
      ),
      direction = case_when(
        log2FoldChange > FC & padj_manual_noNA < pcut  ~ "up",
        log2FoldChange < -FC & padj_manual_noNA < pcut ~ "down",
        TRUE ~ "not_significant"
      )
    )

  # Bring CCL2 to front (draw last)
  obj <- obj %>% arrange(category != "CCL2")
  obj$gene_name <- as.character(obj$gene_name)

  # Print summary stats
  message("Upregulated genes: ", sum(obj$direction == "up"))
  message("Downregulated genes: ", sum(obj$direction == "down"))
  message("ECM pathway genes: ", sum(obj$category == "ECM"))
  message("CCL2 highlighted: ", sum(obj$category == "CCL2"))
  message("Not significant: ", sum(obj$direction == "not_significant"))

  # 5. Volcano plot
  volcano <- EnhancedVolcano(
    obj,
    lab = obj$gene_name,
    x = "log2FoldChange",
    y = "padj_manual_noNA",
    pCutoff = pcut,
    FCcutoff = FC,
    drawConnectors = FALSE,
    xlim = c(-11, 11),
    ylim = c(0, 80),
    selectLab = c("CCL2", ecm_genes),
    colCustom = c(
      "up" = "red",
      "down" = "blue",
      "ECM" = "gold",
      "CCL2" = "maroon3",
      "not_significant" = "gray"
    )[obj$category]
  )

  print(volcano)

  # 6. Save volcano plots
  if(save_plot) {

    if(is.null(plot_file)) {
      plot_file <- file.path(map, "volcano_plot")
    }

    ggsave(
      filename = paste0(plot_file, ".png"),
      plot = volcano,
      width = 8,
      height = 10,
      units = "in",
      dpi = 600
    )

    ggsave(
      filename = paste0(plot_file, ".pdf"),
      plot = volcano,
      width = 8,
      height = 10,
      units = "in"
    )

    message("Volcano plot saved to PNG and PDF at: ", plot_file)
  }


# 7. Save output table (FULL)
output_file <- file.path(map, "deseq2_results_with_direction.csv")
write.csv(obj, output_file, row.names = FALSE)
message("All results saved to: ", output_file)


# 8. Save filtered subset (significant up/down only)

filtered_subset <- obj %>%
  filter(direction != "not_significant")

filtered_file <- file.path(map, "deseq2_results_filtered.csv")

write.csv(filtered_subset, filtered_file, row.names = FALSE)

message("Filtered results saved to: ", filtered_file)

return(obj)
}

# 9 USER INPUT
input_file <- "results/01_differential_expression/condition_mockVZV_VZV_manual_padj.rds"
output_dir <- "results/03_volcano_plot/"
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
plot_file <- file.path(output_dir, "volcano_ECM_noVZV")

# 10. Read DESeq2 data from .rds
data <- readRDS(input_file)

# If the object is DESeqResults, convert to dataframe
if(!is.data.frame(data)) {
  data <- as.data.frame(data)
  data$gene_id <- rownames(data)
}

# Ensure it's a data.frame
if(!is.data.frame(data)) {
  data <- as.data.frame(data)
}

# Ensure gene_id exists
if(!"gene_id" %in% colnames(data)) {
  # If rownames are present, use them
  if(length(rownames(data)) == nrow(data)) {
    data$gene_id <- rownames(data)
  } else {
    stop("No 'gene_id' column found and rownames are missing in the .rds object")
  }
}

# 11. Run analysis
results <- getInfo(
  obj = data,
  pcut = 0.05,
  FC = 1,
  map = output_dir,
  save_plot = TRUE,
  plot_file = plot_file
)
```
